jobs.title: Software Engineering Director, Infrared Data Products
jobs.description:
About The Role

Muon seeks a Software Engineering Director to join our Team. The ideal candidate is passionate about low-latency computer vision pipelines and products.

This position is ideally hybrid at our San Jose, CA office three days per week. However, we will consider exceptional remote candidates as well at approved locations.

Responsibilities

Manage an organization of managers, data scientists, and software engineers.
Lead the team in delivering an ultra-low latency, high-reliability, massive volume data processing pipeline for data from our FireSat constellation for timely updates to customers around the world.
Identify, ensure measurement of, and drive improvement of the right metrics to deliver the performance our customers need from our image processing pipelines.
Create long-term technical strategy and roadmaps to drive new capabilities and new products from infrared and visual imagery.
Train, teach and model the best principles of software engineering and data science.
Communicate clearly and effectively to customers, partner teams and the company as a whole, driving clarity on the team's current and future capabilities.
Drive the vision and mission of the team, in harmony with Muon's broader mission and values.
Establish operational objectives, policies, procedures and work plans and delegate assignments to the team.
Be accountable for the team's successful and predictable delivery against goals and objectives.

Qualifications

BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computational Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science or a related area.
5 years of prior software management experience
Experience building and deploying high volume, ultra-low latency data processing pipelines, ideally with computer vision algorithms.
Experience with geospatial data engineering principles and tooling.
Expert understanding of software engineering processes such as software estimation, DevOps, testing, etc.
Excitement about working in a fast-paced, innovation-focused startup environment.
Expertise in negotiation and managing technical decision-making.

Nice-to-have Skills

Experience writing high-performance data processing in C++ or Python.
Expertise with both classical and modern neural-network-based computer vision techniques.
Experience delivering imagery products to government organizations.
Experience with image processing pipelines from remotely sensed data.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $231,000 - $260,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C.

1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. The Company may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

jobs.title: Transportation Engineering Director
jobs.description:
What Your Day Will Look Like:

As a civil engineering transportation director, you`ll be oversee the planning, design, and maintenance of a public or private organization's transportation infrastructure programs, such as roads, bridges, and transit systems. You`ll manage staff and budgets, develop capital improvement plans, ensure projects meet standards, collaborate with stakeholders, and handle business development and client relations.

What You'll Do:

Direct a team of engineers and technical staff, conducting performance evaluations, and managing budgets and departmental operations.
Develop and implement long-term plans for transportation systems, including capital improvement plans.
Oversee the design and delivery of complex transportation projects to ensure they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
Provide technical guidance and act as the expert on transportation engineering principles, traffic control, and public roadway regulations.
Collaborate with external partners such as government agencies, metropolitan planning organizations, and community groups.
Lead efforts to secure new projects, develop proposals, and negotiate contracts, especially in the private sector.

What You'll Need:

Bachelor of Science in Civil or Structural Engineering.
Minimum Fifteen years of transportation engineering experience.
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Proficiency in AutoCAD and Civil3D software.
This hybrid job operates between an office environment and a field environment and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones and copy machines. May require occasional exposure to work environments that may include inclement weather, heat, humidity, noise, hazard, atmospheric conditions, and bodies of water, depending on project requirements.
While performing the duties of this job, physical demands of the employee include frequent sitting, moving, standing, talking, hearing, and occasional balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, handling, grasping, and feeling. This job may occasionally require operating a company vehicle, and lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling up to 35 lbs.

What Benefits You’ll Enjoy:

We invest in us. Because our team members go above, below, and beyond the surface to care for our communities (inside and out), we do our best to take care of you by providing a
comprehensive benefits package
!
Eligibility for some of the benefits outlined below is based on full-time work status; part-time and contingent positions are only eligible based on hours worked. If you have questions, contact careers@consoreng.com .

Career Growth & Development – Tuition reimbursement program, paid professional training, major license achievement bonus, extensive on-demand learning center, and paid professional memberships.
Work-Life Alignment – Industry-competitive PTO, seven paid holidays and two floating holidays, flexible work schedules, paid parental leave, and eligibility for hybrid and remote work options for some employees based on role responsibilities.
Wellness – Medical, dental and vision insurance, employee assistance program, fitness and wellness reimbursement, and HSA and FSA options.
Life – Employer-paid STD and LTD, employer-paid term life insurance, and retirement 401(k) with company match.
Community – Quarterly social events, paid group volunteering events, and employee networks and groups .

How Your Career Will Grow:

We know career growth is not always linear or streamlined— it’s often squiggly. You may want to explore a management track, try a new technical track, or move laterally to reposition your skills and talents. No matter what level you join us at or how you want to shape your career, we want Consor to be a place where you can learn and grow.

Why You’ll Love Consor:

At Consor, you’ll work with a network of water and transportation professionals who specialize in planning, engineering design, structural assessment, and construction services. Across geographies, you’ll have access to the resources and nationwide expertise found in a large consulting firm, while experiencing a community feel at the local level. You’ll experience a culture where we share in our successes and support one another through challenges. Here, there are countless opportunities to explore your career path by working on projects that help you expand your potential and take your career to new heights! Join our diverse team of experts who live and work alongside client partners, providing thoughtful solutions to create inspiring communities together.

How We Support Diversity:

Consor welcomes and celebrates equality and diversity in the workplace. Throughout our teams and across leadership, Consor pursues an environment in which each employee and prospective employee is treated respectfully, valuing the uniqueness of individuals and differing perspectives and experiences. At the heart of this is ensuring employment practices at Consor provide and promote equal employment and development opportunity for all employees and prospective employees, in accordance with all local, state, and federal laws and regulations governing personnel activities. As such, Consor is an equal opportunity employer and pursues a program of affirmative action across its offices and worksites.

If you need more information or special assistance for persons with disabilities or limited English proficiency , contact Human Resources at 888-451-6822 ext. 55214. jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Head of Engineering is responsible for leading all engineering, product management, quality, compliance, and new product introduction activities across multiple business units and international locations.

This role provides strategic and technical leadership, ensuring engineering excellence while driving innovation, operational efficiency, and exceptional customer satisfaction. Working closely with Sales, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and executive leadership, the successful candidate will build a high-performing engineering organisation capable of supporting long-term business growth and delivering world-class interconnect solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership

Lead engineering activities across multiple global business units.
Build, develop and mentor a high-performing engineering team with clear ownership and accountability.
Foster a culture focused on technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Align closely with global manufacturing engineering teams to ensure efficient product development and successful production launch.

Product Management

Develop and execute the product roadmap in line with business strategy and manufacturing capability.
Manage the existing product portfolio, ensuring complete technical documentation and ongoing product support.
Oversee Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) and Product Change Notices (PCNs) to minimise customer disruption.
Lead product testing and validation programmes to strengthen product performance and market competitiveness.

Design Engineering

Establish an efficient and responsive design engineering function.
Deliver custom and modified product designs to meet customer-specific requirements.
Improve speed to design and speed to quotation.
Drive innovation through concept development, simulation, reverse engineering and design for manufacture.

Engineering Documentation

Review and approve customer drawings and engineering documentation before production release.
Approve design revisions and first article inspections.
Assess customer requirements against manufacturing capabilities, tooling constraints and commercial considerations.

Quality & Compliance

Own engineering quality standards and product compliance across internally manufactured and externally sourced products.
Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements including ISO, IATF 16949, REACH and RoHS.
Ensure timely investigation and resolution of quality issues through effective corrective action processes.

Continuous Improvement

Drive improvements across engineering, quality and compliance processes.
Improve engineering productivity, resource utilisation and project visibility through best practice methodologies.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

Establish a disciplined NPI process that consistently delivers successful product launches aligned with customer and business objectives.

Customer Engagement

Support strategic customer relationships by providing technical leadership throughout the design and product development process.
Partner with commercial teams to secure new business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Ensure close integration between Engineering, Sales, Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain to improve execution speed and business performance.

Team Development

Recruit, develop and retain high-performing engineering professionals across multiple locations.
Create succession plans and support ongoing professional development.

Strategic Leadership

Contribute as a member of the senior leadership team to the development and execution of business strategy.
Ensure engineering capability supports long-term growth, innovation and market expansion.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. An advanced engineering qualification is desirable.

Experience

Minimum of 8 years' engineering experience within electronic components industry.
Proven experience leading engineering teams within a manufacturing environment.
Strong customer-facing engineering experience.
Extensive knowledge of connector design, product development and manufacturing processes.
Experience with APQP, PPAP and IATF 16949 methodologies.
Strong understanding of injection moulding, metal stamping and related manufacturing processes.
Demonstrated success managing cross-functional engineering projects and global teams.

Technical Skills

Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks and other CAD platforms.
Strong engineering drawing interpretation and creation skills.
Excellent knowledge of engineering specifications, testing and validation.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Personal Attributes

Strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness.
Excellent leadership and people development skills.
Outstanding communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Highly organised with exceptional planning and project management capability.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Customer-focused with a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
VP of Engineering - AI Agentic Verification Platform / AI Startup

About our client

Our client is a fast-growing AI startup building an agentic platform for digital verification, helping semiconductor teams accelerate verification planning, execution, debugging, root-cause analysis, and closure. The platform combines AI agents, RAG-based design collateral ingestion, verification workflow automation, and logic-aware analysis to support complex digital verification environments.

The role

This is a full-time, US-based strategic and technical leadership role at the intersection of AI agents, semiconductor verification, and enterprise engineering automation. You will work directly with semiconductor customers to understand their verification workflows, define product requirements, shape high-value use cases, and support pilots, while leading and mentoring cross-functional engineering teams to turn those requirements into a scalable, production-grade AI verification platform.

Please note - you must have full Right to Work in the US to be considered.

This is a permanent, full time role, and is not open on C2C

What you will be doing

Leading technical discovery with semiconductor customers to understand verification workflows, pain points, requirements, adoption concerns, and success criteria
Translating customer requirements into product use cases, workflow definitions, technical specifications, and roadmap priorities
Leading engineering execution, architecture, delivery quality, and technical roadmap implementation as the bridge between customers, product strategy, and engineering
Defining how the platform fits into real verification environments, including simulation, formal, emulation, regressions, debug, CI/CD, coverage, and existing EDA toolchains
Supporting customer demos, proof-of-concept engagements, pilot planning, and technical evaluations
Mentoring internal engineering teams on verification methodology, user expectations, EDA workflows, and practical customer requirements
Reviewing product workflows, demos, and technical outputs for credibility and alignment with how verification teams actually work
Defining proof-of-value metrics that matter to verification leaders, such as debug time reduction, faster root-cause analysis, improved planning quality, better regression insight, or reduced manual effort
Supporting strategic introductions and customer-facing conversations across the US semiconductor ecosystem
Helping refine positioning against existing EDA tools, internal automation flows, and general-purpose AI assistants

What we are looking for

BSEE/MSEE in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
15+ years of experience across semiconductor, EDA, and digital verification environments, with deep expertise across IP, subsystem, and SoC-level projects
Experience working directly with semiconductor customers, verification teams, EDA users, or internal engineering stakeholders
Ability to convert complex technical discussions into structured product requirements and engineering priorities
Strong communication skills with both senior customer stakeholders and hands-on engineers
Ability to mentor engineering teams on verification workflows, customer expectations, and tool usability requirements
Strong product sense: the ability to identify what customers will actually use, evaluate, trust, and pay for
Strong US-based semiconductor ecosystem network, preferably in the Bay Area, Austin/Texas, or another major US semiconductor hub
Prior experience at, or working closely with, semiconductor companies, EDA companies, IP vendors, or verification tool teams

Why join

This is an opportunity to help define a new category at the intersection of AI agents, semiconductor verification, and enterprise engineering automation, working directly with the founding team to shape the product, architecture, technical roadmap, customer strategy, and engineering culture from an early stage.

In accordance with local employment laws, applicants must have current, valid authorisation to work in the US at the time of application. We are unable to sponsor employment visas for this role. Applications from individuals without existing work authorisation for the US cannot be considered.

jobs.description:
The Group

Morningstar's mission is to create products that help investors achieve their financial goals. For the Retirement group, that means building products and solutions that help employers maximize the value of their workplace retirement plans and put individuals on the path to better retirement outcomes. Retirement is a high-growth area for Morningstar offering a diverse suite of technology and investment-based solutions. Our unique client base includes retirement plan providers, sponsors, advisors, consultants, and participants.

The Job Responsibilities

Team Leadership

Lead the North America engineering teams supporting Morningstar Plan Advantage and Fiduciary Services.
Hire, coach, and develop technical leads and engineers while fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical leadership by establishing clear ownership, decision-making practices, architecture and design review standards, and consistent engineering expectations while enabling technical leads and teams to operate independently and deliver predictably.
Continuously improve how engineering teams build and operate software by adopting modern development practices, automation, and operational excellence.

AI-Native Engineering

Lead teams through the shift from AI-assisted to agentic engineering — engineers set direction, build the context and guardrails agents work within, and verify outcomes rather than producing the implementation themselves.
Own the engineering environment that makes agent-authored work trustworthy: context, standards enforced through automated checks, and feedback that catches defects before human review. Accountability for what ships stays with engineers — AI-generated work doesn't reduce or transfer it.
Measure whether it's working — cycle time across the full delivery lifecycle rather than coding alone, rework rate on agent-authored work, and no compromise in quality, security, compliance, or accessibility.

Delivery & Cross-functional Execution

Own successful execution of initiatives that span multiple applications and engineering teams by driving alignment, managing dependencies, removing blockers, and maintaining delivery momentum.
Partner closely with Product Management to shape roadmaps, clarify priorities, and balance near-term needs with platform modernization.
Build strong working relationships across engineering and product organizations, encouraging direct communication, shared ownership, and collaborative problem solving.

The Qualifications

8+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams with direct people management responsibility.
Strong technical depth in distributed systems, including service architecture, API design, data consistency, resiliency, and performance, with the ability to review designs and identify scalability and operational risks.
Hands-on proficiency with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and cloud-native development on AWS, with enough front-end depth in modern component-based JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks to review full-stack designs end to end, and the ability to review architecture, designs, and code and provide technical guidance to engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience delivering complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams and applications, driving execution, managing dependencies, and resolving cross-team technical challenges.
Experience adopting AI-assisted engineering practices including coding agents, AI-assisted code reviews, testing, and documentation with the ability to establish appropriate guardrails, verification practices, and engineering standards while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and engineering judgment.
Working knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, SLOs, secure SDLC, and cloud-native operational practices.
Experience developing engineers and technical leads with a track record of growing individuals into broader technical and leadership responsibilities.
Demonstrated ability to build collaborative engineering teams and foster a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and direct cross-functional communication.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions, navigate ambiguity, and build trusted partnerships across groups.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

We're looking for a technical leader to help us continue to scale the service with great people and reliable, cost-effective, and efficient infrastructure, processes, and tooling.

jobs.description:
Overview

This is a hybrid role. 2 days remote (Monday, Friday) and 3 days onsite (Tuesday-Thursday)

The Director, Cloud Infrastructure is accountable for the strategy, reliability, and continuous improvement of the company’s enterprise technology services, including infrastructure engineering, cloud platforms, and operational governance.

This role leads multiple technical and service delivery teams and serves as the primary owner of core IT operations that enable business continuity and teammate productivity across all locations. The Director balances long-term modernization initiatives with day-to-day operational excellence, ensuring systems are secure, resilient, scalable, and aligned with business growth.

The position partners closely with Security, Applications, Finance, and Audit to manage risk, maintain regulatory compliance, and deliver a stable and high-quality technology experience for the organization.

Who We Are

At CubeSmart, we’re intentional about culture. You can experience it everywhere from our mission statement of “genuine care” to our “It’s What’s Inside That Counts” tagline to calling each other “teammates” rather than employees. This spirit fosters a fun and collaborative environment that has resulted in our rapid growth and being recognized amongst the top in our industry.

CubeSmart’s award-winning team is made up of people who genuinely care. Teammates care about our customers and the life events and/or business needs they are facing. Teammates are passionate, responsible and understanding. The CubeSmart team is made up of people who have a can-do attitude, are committed to their own success and the success of the company, and lead by example.

If this sounds like a team and culture that matches your personal values and motivations, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for infrastructure and operations services
Lead hybrid cloud strategy across Azure, AWS, and Microsoft 365
Establish standards for availability, scalability, resiliency, automation, and cost optimization
Drive lifecycle planning for compute, storage, networking, identity, and endpoint platforms
Evaluate new technologies and vendors to modernize and simplify the environment
Align infrastructure investments to business priorities and growth plans

Infrastructure & Platform Operations

Own availability, performance, and security of:
Data centers and hosted environments
Cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365)
Core enterprise systems and identity services
Backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity platforms
Endpoint/device management platforms

Ensure SLAs and operational targets are consistently achieved
Lead incident, change, and problem management practices
Oversee monitoring, alerting, and operational health reporting
Provide senior-level technical escalation and decision-making

Reliability Engineering & Service Excellence

Reduce recurring incidents and operational risk through proactive improvements
Champion operational maturity and continuous service improvement

Ensure appropriate access management, logging, backup, and recovery standards
Participate in audits, assessments, and remediation efforts
Maintain documentation and processes to support regulatory requirements

Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead managers and technical teams across infrastructure engineering, support services, and telecommunications
Set priorities, capacity plans, and performance expectations
Coach and develop leaders and senior engineers
Foster a culture of accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement

Financial & Vendor Management

Own infrastructure and operations budgets and forecasting
Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and renewals
Negotiate hardware, cloud, telecom, and services agreements
Balance cost optimization with performance and reliability needs

Translate business requirements into scalable and reliable solutions

Collaborate cross-functionally with Security, Applications, Finance, and Workplace teams

Hybrid cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365)

ITSM platforms and operational tooling
Compliance and operational controls (SOX/PCI)

Experience managing budgets, vendors, and contracts

jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

YOUR MISSION

True Anomaly is building a new Platform Engineering organization to own the compute infrastructure that powers everything we do, from autonomous spacecraft to classified command-and-control software. As VP of Platform Engineering, you will build this organization from day one. You will hire and lead teams across AI engineering, data engineering, infrastructure engineering, and IT. You will set the technical vision for how the company builds, deploys, and operates across commercial, CUI, and classified environments. The platforms your team creates will serve every program in the company and position True Anomaly to offer accredited compute as a strategic capability in the defense market. This role has direct impact on the company’s ability to scale.

Responsibilities

Build and lead the Platform Engineering organization from the ground up: hiring managers, setting technical direction, and scaling a team to 24+ in 2026 with significant continued growth as the company expands its program portfolio and prime capabilities
Own the company’s compute infrastructure platform strategy across commercial, CUI, and classified environments, including cloud, containers, networking, and CI/CD
Define and deliver the technical architecture for DoD Impact Level 5 and IL-6 accredited compute environments, replacing subcontractor dependency with a reusable, internally owned platform
Drive AI enablement infrastructure as the company’s top strategic priority, including the AI platform, data infrastructure, and enterprise AI tooling that the rest of the company depends on
Lead the Systems Working Group: technology evaluation, approval, and standardization across the company, backed by the engineering capacity to drive outcomes
Partner with engineering leadership, program teams, and government customers to ensure infrastructure scales with the contract pipeline and positions True Anomaly to offer accredited compute as a prime capability

Hands-on expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GovCloud variants), Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, and CI/CD at scale
Direct experience building and operating DoD Impact Level 5 or higher accredited environments, with working knowledge of NIST 800-53, STIGs, RMF, and the ATO process
Track record of building engineering organizations from scratch in high-growth environments: recruiting teams, establishing culture, and delivering platforms that other teams depend on
Experience managing teams that operate across classification levels with mixed clearance requirements

Experience in aerospace, defense, or national security technology companies
Background spanning multiple infrastructure disciplines: AI/ML platforms, data engineering, networking, and SRE/DevOps
Experience with multi-cloud and hybrid architectures including on-premises, GovCloud, and customer-deployed or disconnected environments
Prior experience at a high-growth startup (Series B through IPO) building infrastructure that scales with rapid headcount and contract growth
Familiarity with platform engineering “paved roads” operating models that balance standardization with engineering team autonomy

jobs.title: VP, Global Engineering and Automation Enablement
jobs.description:
VP, Global Engineering and Automation Enablement Role Overview

We are seeking a senior Technology Leader to own the architecture, scalability, and intelligent automation of our core FinTech platforms. This role is responsible for designing large-scale, cloud-native, distributed systems while leveraging AI-driven automation to improve platform efficiency, reliability, and operational scale.
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in platform architecture and distributed systems with a strong point of view on using AI to automate infrastructure operations, optimize performance, and enable predictive, self-healing platforms. This is a highly technical leadership role with material influence over how the platform scales as the business grows.

VP, Global Engineering and Automation Enablement Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Technical Strategy

Own the end-to-end platform architecture supporting core FinTech products and transaction flows
Define architectural standards for scalability, performance, resiliency, and system composability
Lead evolution from tightly coupled or monolithic systems toward distributed, service-oriented platforms
Establish clear system boundaries, ownership models, and architectural governance
Define and execute a multi-year platform roadmap aligned with growth, transaction scale, and product velocity

Scalability & Distributed System

Design platforms capable of handling high transaction volumes, burst traffic, and sustained throughput
Guide horizontal scaling strategies across compute, storage, data, and messaging layers
Lead architectural decisions around sharding, partitioning, caching, asynchronous processing, and concurrency
Continuously improve latency, throughput, and resource efficiency across the platform
Enable multi-region and multi-environment scalability where required

Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture

Architect cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) optimized for scale, availability, and operational efficiency
Define reference architectures for containerized workloads, microservices, and distributed runtimes
Lead Kubernetes and container platform adoption and standardization
Mature Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.) for consistent, scalable environments
Own capacity modeling, growth forecasting, and infrastructure lifecycle planning

AI-Driven Automation & Intelligent Platforms

Apply AI and machine learning techniques to automate platform operations and decision-making

Use AI for:
Capacity forecasting and demand prediction
Anomaly detection in platform performance and system behavior
Automated root-cause analysis and incident correlation
Predictive scaling and infrastructure optimization
Drive adoption of self-healing platform patterns where systems can respond automatically to failure or degradation
Enable data pipelines, feature stores, and runtime environments required to support AI-enabled platform services
Partner with data and engineering teams to productionize AI capabilities within core platform workflows

Platform Engineering & Developer Enablement

Build shared platform capabilities that abstract complexity and enable product teams to scale independently
Provide self-service infrastructure, golden paths, and opinionated platform tooling
Standardize CI/CD, runtime environments, observability, and deployment patterns
Reduce friction and cognitive load for application teams through strong platform design
Measure and improve developer experience as a platform outcome

Reliability, Performance & Intelligent Operations

Lead SRE practices focused on scalability, automation, and operational maturity
Define and track SLIs/SLOs centered on throughput, latency, availability, and platform health
Establish advanced observability (metrics, tracing, logging) as inputs to AI-driven insights
Lead analysis of scaling failures, performance bottlenecks, and systemic inefficiencies
Drive continuous improvement toward predictable, automated, and resilient operations

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems
5+ years in senior technical leadership roles (Director, Principal, VP, or equivalent)
Deep expertise in platform architecture, cloud-native design, and system scalability
Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP
Proven experience with microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed data systems
Solid background in Infrastructure as Code and automation-first platform design
Experience applying AI/ML concepts to operational or platform use cases

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with high-volume transaction processing or real-time systems
Strong Kubernetes and container platform experience
Experience with event streaming platforms (Kafka or equivalent)
Background modernizing legacy platforms at scale
Experience with AI-assisted operations, AIOps, or intelligent monitoring platforms

Key Competencies

Systems-level architectural thinking with a strong scalability mindset
Ability to blend platform engineering and AI automation into practical solutions
Technical credibility with senior engineers, architects, and leadership
Pragmatic decision-maker who balances ideal architecture with real-world constraints
Strong communicator who can translate technical strategy into business impact

30-60-90 Day Success Plan

First 30 Days – Understand & Assess

Develop deep understanding of current platform architecture and scaling limits
Review system topology, transaction paths, and performance characteristics
Identify opportunities for automation, AI-driven optimization, and architectural simplification
Build strong relationships across engineering, data, and product leadership

Days 31–60 – Architect & Automate

Define target-state platform architecture with explicit scalability patterns
Prioritize architectural improvements with the highest scale and automation leverage
Introduce AI-enabled insights into observability, capacity, or incident analysis
Establish platform standards, reference architectures, and design principles

Days 61–90 – Scale & Industrialize

Deliver measurable improvements in throughput, latency, and platform stability
Advance automation toward self-service, self-scaling, and self-healing capabilities
Roll out platform-level AI automation for operations and performance optimization
Finalize a multi-year platform and AI-automation roadmap
Establish a culture of building intelligent systems designed to scale by default

jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

We’re transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization.

Collectors is committed to utilize cybersecurity, risk and privacy best practices on our platforms, leveraging signal intelligence and observability at scale to protect our customers, employees and our brand. We’re looking for a Director of Internal Platforms and Developer Experience to join our Platform Engineering team to partner with the broader Product and Tech org and build the foundational systems that our engineers rely on to build, deploy and run our applications.

You’ll report to the VP of Engineering, Information Security and Platforms. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.

What You’ll Do

Define and drive the platform engineering strategy across infrastructure, developer experience, and AI enablement, ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals and technology roadmaps.
Lead and develop multiple engineering teams responsible for core infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, cloud services, and the internal developer platform, fostering a culture of reliability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Own the vision for developer experience, ensuring internal teams have access to well-documented, self-service tooling and platforms that reduce friction and accelerate the path from code to production.
Establish and oversee AI enablement strategies, including the evaluation, integration, and governance of AI-assisted development tools and frameworks, ensuring teams can adopt AI capabilities responsibly and effectively.
Define guardrails and governance frameworks for AI adoption, partnering with security, legal, and compliance stakeholders to create policies that balance innovation velocity with risk management, data privacy, and responsible use.
Set standards for platform reliability, scalability, and security, driving investment in observability, incident response, infrastructure-as-code, and capacity planning to support the organization's growth.
Partner cross-functionally with product engineering, security, data, and architecture leaders to ensure platform capabilities meet current and emerging needs across the organization.
Champion a platform-as-a-product mindset, using internal feedback loops, adoption metrics, and developer satisfaction data to continuously iterate on the platforms and services your teams provide.

Who You Are

A seasoned engineering leader with 10+ years of experience in software or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years managing engineering teams and at least 2+ years leading managers or multiple teams simultaneously.
Deeply technical with a strategic mindset. You've built or scaled platform and infrastructure organizations and can move fluidly between architectural decisions and organizational strategy without losing sight of either.
An expert in modern infrastructure and platform tooling, with hands-on experience across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container orchestration (k8s), CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), infrastructure-as-code (Terrafor/Crossplane), and observability stacks.
A champion of developer experience. You've operated with a platform-as-a-product philosophy, and you have a track record of building internal tooling and self-service platforms that measurably improve developer productivity and satisfaction.
Fluent in the AI-assisted development landscape. You understand the current ecosystem of AI coding assistants, code generation tools, and LLM-based development frameworks, and you've led or contributed to organizational strategies for adopting them thoughtfully.
Governance-minded without being risk-averse. You know how to design guardrails and policies around emerging technology — particularly AI — that protect the organization without stifling innovation, and you're comfortable partnering with security, legal, and compliance teams to get there.
A strong cross-functional partner. You build trust easily with product engineering, architecture, security, and business stakeholders, and you're skilled at translating platform capabilities into business value.
Operationally excellent. You've managed cloud infrastructure budgets, vendor relationships, and capacity planning at scale, and you bring a disciplined approach to headcount planning and resource allocation.
An effective communicator who can articulate platform strategy and technical trade-offs to audiences ranging from individual contributors to executive leadership with equal clarity.

Bain’s Vector leads the firm’s software development efforts and defines engineering standards for Bain globally.

Drive client improvements in AI-assisted or AI-led maturity across people, process, and technology. 
Mentor and coach developers to improve productivity through adoption of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex etc.)
Lead in designing, developing, and documenting AI applications aligned to business outcomes.
Develop prompt engineering strategies, implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and optimize model inference latency and cost
Develop and champion modern software development best practices and concepts to technical audience and business stakeholders.
Lead cross functional teams to develop and deploy production quality code for clients.
Lead full software development life cycle execution including architecture design, writing documentation and unit/integration tests, identifying issues and resolution, writing clean code, conducting code reviews, and mentoring other Engineers.

Drive AI-led or AI-assisted transformation to improve productivity and quality across the PDLC  
Explore new innovations in AI and software development to further improve productivity and modularity.
Mentor and coach engineering teams on technology stack best practices and operational models to raise their software engineering capabilities.
Lead ideation processes, alongside consulting and client colleagues, to bring innovative solutions to problems.
Drive engagements that help to understand current state of clients’ architecture, micro-services, build processes, and security needs.
Lead in a collaborative manner with clients’ technical teams to define technical approaches to implementing designed solutions, including new product architecture, data flows and integration strategies, and build processes.

Translate business requirements into technical requirements and implementation details Lead development of complex systems that are extensible, easy to understand, and self-maintaining.
Design integrations with third-party systems to enable use cases that power business solutions.

Work closely with product and design to create modern AI systems. Architect and design end-to-end AI agent systems, including reasoning loops, planning mechanisms, and tool orchestration frameworks

Design and implement multi-agent architectures (planner, executor, verifier, critic patterns)
Architect and build scalable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with optimized embedding and retrieval strategies

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for someone who has:

Bachelor’s in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent work experience.
Experience in an engineering role at a start-up or fast-growing tech company, with a strong track record of increasing mastery and responsibility.
10+ years of experience with full-stack development.
6+ years of experience with micro-service API development (e.g., RESTful, GraphQL, gRPC) with frameworks (e.g. FastAPI, Swagger, OpenAPI etc.).
4+ years of experience in consulting.
2+ years of experience leading or managing development teams
1+ years of experience with AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
Strong knowledge in development best practices (automated testing frameworks, CI/CD etc.).
Strong computer science fundaments in data structures, algorithms, automated testing, object-oriented programming, performance complexity, and implications of computer architecture on software performance.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills,
Deep understanding of large language models (LLMs) and transformer architectures
Strong knowledge of prompt engineering, structured prompting, and reasoning control techniques
Experience designing and deploying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems
Ability to evaluate model performance beyond accuracy (reasoning quality, hallucination rate, task success)
Understanding of tokenization, context window limits, and cost optimization strategies
Strong Python proficiency for AI development

Ideal candidates will also have experience in:

Master’s in computer science or a related technical field.
Experience working with or providing services to enterprise customers (Fortune 500, Global 1000).
Experience working on public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and associated deep understanding of failover, high-availability, and high scalability.
Ability to explain and discuss technical concepts and methodologies with colleagues and clients from other disciplines.

Lead post-510(k) engineering support and product life cycle management for released robotic systems across clinical applications, including service operations, complaint handling, and sustaining engineering activities.

Demonstrated ability to lead through influence to drive engagement and focus on critical priorities with cross-functional teams.

Outstanding interpersonal and organizational skills.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

About The Role

Roblox Studio is the creation engine behind millions of immersive 3D games built by creators around the world. We are entering a major platform transition, evolving Studio into an AI-Native IDE where intelligent systems plan, act, validate, and iterate alongside creators to amplify their output. We are seeking a Technical Director, Applied AI to own the technical direction of the agentic AI systems embedded deeply into Roblox Studio. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role operating at the intersection of platform engineering, AI systems, and developer experience, where you will set the technical direction, design the architecture, and write the code.

You Will

Design and build the agentic AI systems at the core of the AI-Native IDE (planning, execution, validation, evaluation) so they are production-grade and reliable.
Decide how Studio uses coding models, agents, retrieval, tool calling, and context management across the Assistant and the broader creator workflow.
Own the quality bar and evaluation strategy, standing up quantitative and qualitative eval pipelines, including human-in-the-loop, so we ship with confidence.
Optimize these systems for latency, throughput, and cost (caching, routing, distillation, quantization).
Bring reusable patterns and best practices to teams across Studio, raising the applied-AI fluency of Studio engineering.

You Have

12+ years of engineering experience, including ownership of large-scale, long-lived platforms.
Deep, hands-on experience building LLM-powered and agentic systems in production, beyond chat-based interfaces.
Strong systems and software engineering skills, with the ability to design the architecture and write the code.
A track record of defining evaluation frameworks for AI product quality, combining automated metrics with human review, and optimizing inference for latency, throughput, and cost.
Strong background in developer tools or IDE-like platforms, with a proven ability to set technical direction and raise quality across multiple teams as an individual contributor.
Preferred Qualifications: Background in coding models or code-generation systems, and/or research experience in reinforcement learning (RLHF, RLAIF, preference modeling) or related model-training techniques.

You Are

An innovative technical leader who wants to build the AI systems that power the creativity of millions.
Product-minded, with a real understanding of developer needs, creator workflows, and how AI systems land in the user experience.
Adaptable and curious, with good judgment about when to build, when to reuse, and when to push a need back to a model team.
Able to operate at the deepest technical levels and still communicate direction clearly to partners.

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page
.

Annual Salary Range

$399,420—$457,970 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Experience inspiring and developing geographically distributed teams. Proven ability to influence executive leadership levels across multiple functions, inspiring cross-functional teams to achieve shared business goals.

Expertise in translating complex support metrics (CR, CPC, RCR) and customer feedback into business impact and product roadmaps.
Deep understanding of refund fraud reduction, gift card scam mitigation, and risk-based decision-making.
Proven track record in launching and supporting large-scale hardware products or global-scaled hardware retail.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and lead complex projects.

About The Job

In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more).

The mission of the Platforms and Devices (P&D) team in gUP is to support users (end users, partners, small businesses, etc.) for Google’s consumer products and services such as Pixel, Google Fi, Home and Health, Google Store, Google subscriptions as well as Google Store.

As the Head of gUP P&D for Google Store Product and Customer Support Excellence, you will lead a high-performing team of Product Support Managers and assist cross-functional effort. You are responsible for delivering a customer support experience for the Google Store, spanning online and a growing network of offline, primarily hardware, retail with a global footprint. You will act as a strategic consultant to the Google Store Product area, translating complex user feedback and friction points into actionable insights that shape the future of the Store portions of the Pixel ecosystem, Store product roadmaps and customer support strategies. Your mission is to advocate customer trust, mitigate fraud, and scale support operations through innovative AI and automation.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video .

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Implement next-generation machine learning and AI conversational support systems to automate user interactions, streamline workflows, and significantly decrease global contact rates across operations.
Synthesize customer feedback to resolve critical journey gaps, manage bug hotlists, and guarantee complete operational readiness while exceeding core launch metrics.

What you'll do...

Position Summary

Walmart is seeking an experienced Sr Manager, Launch Readiness & Ramp Execution to lead business readiness, go-live planning, startup execution, and operational ramp-up for automation programs across the supply chain network. This role owns the integrated launch plan across Engineering, Operations, Technology, Construction, Transportation, Finance, vendors, and site leadership to ensure facilities are ready to launch safely, stabilize quickly, and achieve targeted business outcomes.

What You'll Do

Lead Launch Strategy and Readiness Planning

Develop and execute integrated launch readiness strategies for automation programs across greenfield and retrofit facilities.
Establish go-live frameworks, readiness scorecards, launch criteria, and decision-making routines.
Coordinate commissioning, startup, stabilization, ramp, and transition-to-operations activities.

Own Ramp-Up Performance

Develop ramp strategies, performance targets, launch sequencing, and site stabilization plans.
Monitor KPIs including throughput, productivity, service levels, issue closure, staffing readiness, training readiness, and system performance.
Drive issue resolution during startup, hypercare, and stabilization to accelerate time to steady-state operations.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

Lead alignment across Engineering, Operations, Technology, Construction, Transportation, Finance, vendors, and site leadership.
Facilitate launch governance, readiness reviews, executive updates, dependency management, and escalation processes.
Translate technical execution status into business readiness decisions and operational risk mitigation plans.

Ensure Operational Readiness

Partner with Operations to validate staffing, training, maintenance readiness, test freight, process readiness, and support coverage.
Align engineering deliverables with operational requirements, service commitments, labor plans, transportation impacts, and business objectives.
Support successful handoff from implementation to hypercare, stabilization, and steady-state ownership.

Capture and Scale Launch Learnings

Document launch and ramp lessons learned and convert them into repeatable launch / ramp frameworks.
Improve startup methodologies, readiness tools, stakeholder cadences, and go / no-go decision practices.
Apply learnings across future automation programs to reduce launch risk and accelerate value realization.

What You'll Bring

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, or related field.
5+ years leading startup, launch, implementation, commissioning, operational readiness, or transformation programs.
Experience coordinating large cross-functional teams and stakeholder groups.
Experience managing operational readiness, go-live planning, ramp execution, or stabilization activities.

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or advanced degree preferred.
Experience with distribution center startups, automation deployments, material handling systems, or large-scale operational transformations.
Experience with business readiness, hypercare, stabilization, capacity planning, labor planning, or launch command-center models.
Supply chain, logistics, distribution, warehouse operations, or manufacturing startup experience.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Thrives in fast-paced launch, startup, and stabilization environments.
Strong operational mindset with the ability to connect technical execution to business outcomes.
Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication, and decision facilitation skills.
Comfortable leading through ambiguity, operational pressure, and competing priorities.

Overview

Live the experience
. From professional empowerment to continual learning opportunities. From ongoing investment in new and emerging technologies to a career of self-determination. At Ulta Beauty, our tech team is critical to our scalability—and is recognized that way. We’ve been defined as a “mature start-up.” A place where interdepartmental exposure, open doors, and genuine collaboration is ubiquitous. Where challenges come fast and furious, requiring agility, mental dexterity, and creativity. Where our passion for better solutions
drives us and is core to who we are.

We’re engineering for the future of retail, and it’s no-holds-barred. But for those motivated by continual change and ambiguity, by superior leadership, by whip smart colleagues who will press you daily for your very best, you’ll find that virtually nothing’s impossible at Ulta Beauty.

THE IMPACT YOU CAN HAVE:

The Senior Manager, AI Platform Architecture
is a hands-on leader responsible for the architecture and evolution of our core AI platforms. In this role, you will manage a team of skilled engineers and architects, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and help set the strategic direction of platform architecture to ensure scalability, performance, and reliability across our systems. Your expertise in platform architecture, cloud technologies, automation, and AIML Ops practices will be critical in driving our strategy and ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our systems.

YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH THESE GOALS BY:

Strategic Platform Leadership

Translate enterprise AI strategy defined by the AI Architect Principal, Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise AI Tech Leaders (AI Engineering, DS/ML Engineering, AI Emerging Tech), AI Product Teams into actionable platform roadmaps and technical priorities.
Partner with data, cloud, security, and infrastructure teams to define the end-to-end AI architecture framework, including compute, model lifecycle, and deployment strategies.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend platform enhancements to improve model performance, scalability, and sustainability.
Define and deliver AI/ML/Agentic operations strategy – including tool suite, standards, and technology/capability roadmap.
Establish POV on key evaluations – including, but not limited to “buy v. build”, platform assessments, tool comparisons, cost/performance optimizations
Drive the technical strategy for the platform, balancing short-term needs with long-term scalability and reliability.
Design, implement, and scale cloud-based infrastructures (GCP and Databricks) to support internal and external applications.
Oversee platform architecture decisions, ensuring that the platform is robust, efficient, and capable of supporting growing business needs.

Architecture Design and Governance

Lead the design of core AIML platform components—data pipelines, model training and inference engines, orchestration workflows, and monitoring frameworks.
Design for continuous training pipelines and promote automation capabilities where possible
Establish architectural best practices, patterns, and standards for AI/ML development and deployment.
Oversee design reviews and ensure compliance with enterprise architecture and regulatory requirements.
Design and build platform to meet AI Governance requirements (including application of controls and measurement of controls). Ensure observability requirements can be met.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with product, data science, engineering, and security teams to operationalize AI/ML capabilities across the enterprise.
Partner with the AI Architect Principal and AI Solution Architects to align agentic platform evolution with organizational priorities and technology roadmaps.
Collaborate with security and operations teams to ensure the platform is secure, compliant, and maintains high uptime and reliability.
Engage with leadership to align technical initiatives with organizational objectives.

Team Leadership and Talent Development

Manage and mentor a team of AI engineers, AI architects, and AI Ops engineers.
Foster a high-performance culture emphasizing innovation, collaboration, and agile delivery.
Support career development, technical upskilling, and diversity in AI technology roles, specifically those aligned into the Architecture space. Mentor and guide junior team members.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide career development guidance, and support team members’ growth and skill development.
Own hiring, onboarding, and team-building activities to ensure the team has the right talent and skills.
Provide hands-on technical leadership, leading by example in designing and building robust, scalable systems.
Drive high standards of code quality, testing, and engineering practices.
Advocate for platform engineering best practices, ensuring systems are maintainable, extensible, and documented.

Operational Excellence

Oversee platform scalability, reliability, and cost optimization across cloud and on-prem environments.
Implement observability and monitoring tools to proactively identify performance or security issues.
Ensure platform compliance with responsible AI, data privacy, and ethical ML principles.
Build and develop architecture audit process, and execute
Identify opportunities for automation, process improvements, and tooling that enhance platform reliability and efficiency.
Stay current with emerging technologies and industry best practices and incorporate relevant trends into the platform strategy.
Lead incident response and post-mortem reviews to continuously improve platform resilience.

Platform Performance & Reliability:

Define, implement, and monitor key platform performance metrics, including system uptime, latency, and resource utilization.
Ensure the platform is scalable and cost-efficient, optimizing for performance and operational cost management.
Lead efforts to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve platform performance issues or outages.

ESSENTIALS FOR SUCCESS:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related field, or applicable work experience.
10+ years of experience in software development or architecture; minimum of 3+ years in a leadership role
Deep knowledge of AI/ML ecosystems
Experience designing MLOps pipelines and AI Ops frameworks at enterprise scale
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture (AWS, Azure, Databricks or GCP), MLOps frameworks, and CI/CD principles
Experience with multi-agent architecture concepts: orchestration patterns, tool/skill registry, memory and state management, and agent observability
Experience setting technical standards and coordinating across distributed engineering teams
Proven ability to lead cross-functional engineering teams and deliver enterprise-scale AI solutions.
Comfortable navigating new, novel technology solutions and managing ambiguity to deliver in evolving domains
Familiarity with security and compliance standards for platform operations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset.
Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Company Overview

We are the better way to work in finance. As private equity’s value creation partner, we sit at the heart of PE—where sponsors and CFOs meet. Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive value—supporting the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.

If you crave challenging work and are looking to grow, come solve complex issues alongside 1,600+ finance & technology experts in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Backed by premier private equity firms and headquartered in New York with 11 offices around the globe, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm looking for people who want to be part of building something great. Come make your mark.

Data & Analytics

Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) team offers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.

We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.

We deliver data and analytical solutions designed to streamline reporting capabilities and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Lead end-to-end delivery of modern data platforms for our clients—owning scope, schedule, budget, and outcomes. You’ll run agile delivery teams, guide medallion/lakehouse architectures, and partner with clients to translate business goals into scalable solutions on Snowflake, Azure & Databricks.

Own program delivery: Drive planning, execution, risk/issue management, RAID logs, dependencies, and executive status reporting across multi-workstream data initiatives.
Lead agile teams: Stand up and mature Scrum/Kanban ceremonies, backlog hygiene, velocity forecasting, and release management across data engineering, analytics, and platform ops.
Architectural stewardship: Ensure adherence to medallion (bronze/silver/gold) patterns, data contracts, CI/CD for data, and governance/quality controls (DQ rules, lineage, observability).

Client leadership: Serve as the day-to-day executive contact; run steering committees, manage change requests, and drive stakeholder alignment and adoption.

Enablement: Coach PMs and tech leads; codify playbooks/templates for repeatable delivery; contribute to proposals and pre-sales as needed.
Travel to client sites as needed

10+ years of technology delivery with 5+ years leading data platform or analytics programs in consulting/professional services.
Proven success managing $1M–$5M+ multi-workstream programs with distributed teams.
Hands-on familiarity with Snowflake (warehouses, RBAC, performance/cost tuning) and Azure data services (ADF/Fabric, Databricks, Synapse, ADLS, networking & security).
Strong command of agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban), Jira/Azure DevOps, release planning, and CI/CD for data (Git-based workflows, environments).
Practical experience implementing medallion architectures and lakehouse patterns, data modeling, and data quality/observability.
Stakeholder management at VP/C-suite level; crisp written/oral communication and executive reporting.
Nice to have: regulated industries, FinOps for data platforms, data privacy/compliance (GDPR/CCPA), and analytics enablement (Power BI/Fabric).

Preferred Requirements

BS/MS in CS, IS, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
PMP, PMI-ACP, or SAFe; Snowflake SnowPro; Microsoft Azure (DP-203, AZ-305) a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Programs delivered on-time/on-budget with measurable business outcomes (e.g., SLA improvements, cost per query reductions, faster time-to-insight).
Stable, secure, and cost-efficient Snowflake/Azure platforms with clear operating models and playbooks.
High client satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) and referenceable accounts.
