jobs.title: Director Engineering - Synthetic Molecule Design and Development
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

At Lilly, Synthetic Molecule Design and Development (SMDD) is involved in key activities for the development of synthetic active pharmaceutical ingredients from pre-clinical phases through commercialization of drug substances and drug products. Our scientists and engineers develop key technical and business solutions across the portfolio using their deep technical expertise to accelerate testing of the clinical hypothesis and overall drug development. SMDD delivers on these responsibilities by recognizing diverse talent and cultures are necessary to bring the next generation of life changing medicines to patients.

Position Summary

Our team is looking for experienced, creative, and energetic candidates to lead unit operation development and process optimization of synthetic drug candidates to support clinical trials, regulatory submission, and product commercialization. The position presents an opportunity to lead dynamic teams comprised of process chemists, analytical chemists, formulation scientists, and engineers.

Responsibilities

Possess fluent knowledge in unit operation design, process modeling, process equipment selection, and scale-up methodologies with a drive to challenge existing methods; create and apply cutting edge technology and novel platforms within a time constrained environment.
Familiarity and working knowledge of modern synthetic organic chemistry.
Demonstrate high learning agility with the ability to understand and exploit new scientific concepts and methods across multiple disciplines; be able to apply these learnings to a portfolio of small molecule, oligonucleotide, and synthetic peptide modalities.
Lead and/or supervise the design and development of new synthetic routes for the manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredients using the most modern technologies, including continuous processing, automated reaction screening, PAT, and modeling and simulation.
Ability to lead a cross-disciplinary team to evaluate and refine new manufacturing routes, manufacturing technologies, and practices to deliver a challenging portfolio.
Comfortable with scientific uncertainty and the ability to translate hypotheses into action.
Encourage team members to take initiative and accountability to achieve goals; draws out and encourages others to share knowledge.
Provide technical guidance in the scale-up and demonstration of new chemical processes in development and commercial scale equipment. Participate in technology transfer activities to CRO/CMO organizations and Lilly manufacturing to ensure processes are technically sound, well developed and characterized, and safe.
Design laboratory experimentation in support of process design, definition, optimization, and technology transfer objectives. Ability to generate process (and property design) data based on a fundamental understanding of the underlying physical processes. Utilize advancements in technology (PAT) and modeling platforms to understand and direct experimental protocols.
Plan and manage short term and long-term development activities. Develop and/or review technical agendas and timelines for project work. Recommend resource allocation to accomplish projects according to plans, communicate progress and propose changes in timeline, objectives, or direction.
Collaborate with internal and external manufacturing partners to develop robust chemical process that are readily amenable to efficient drug substance manufacturing.
Collaborate closely with Product Delivery, Project Management, Quality, Manufacturing, and Regulatory scientists to execute and deliver material and information for clinical trials and regulatory submissions.
Embrace diverse thought, background, and experience to deliver innovative solutions.
Possess strong communication (oral, written), organizational, and leadership skills.
Supervise, mentor and develop scientific staff. Ensure continued technical and professional growth of group members, encourage efforts towards excellence and knowledge sharing.
Active participant in the external environment and the ability to recognize and apply external innovation and across the Lilly synthetic portfolio.
Possess deep understanding of the external global regulatory climate and emerging requirements. Ability to address key CMC regulatory questions that enable clinical studies and support marketing authorization applications.

Basic Qualifications

Ph.D. in chemical engineering or a closely related field with 8+ years of experience; or MS degree with 15+ years of experience.
Experience developing chemical processes the from mid-development cycle (proof of concept) to product commercialization required
Experience with technical transfer of processes into manufacturing operations required
Experience within the pharmaceutical sector is desired; however, other relevant experience may meet expectations. Prior experience in the development of an active ingredient and associated formulated product is acceptable. Relevant industrial sectors include agrochemicals, nutraceuticals, specialty chemicals, and personal care products.

Additional Skills/Preferences

Experience with authoring regulatory submissions and responding to regulatory questions.
Experience with modeling and simulation tools, data analytics, and predictive analytics.
Experience with online and offline analytical techniques and process analytical technologies (PAT).
Strong technical skills to supply business value.
Creativity and ability to transform ideas into marketable products and processes.
Knowledge and experience with management of a technical project.
Demonstrated leadership capabilities especially in a team environment.
Demonstrated ability to drive and accept change.
Demonstrated success in persuasion, influence and negotiation.
Good interpersonal skills and a sustained tendency for collaboration.
Ability to prioritize multiple activities and manage ambiguity.
Ability to influence others to promote a positive work environment.
Understanding and awareness of the external scientific and regulatory landscape.
Demonstrated initiative and risk-taking.
Demonstrated technical proficiency and ability to create ideas for future work plans.
Established external publication record.

Additional Information

Travel: 0 -10%
Position Local: Indianapolis, IN; Lilly Technology Center-North (LTC-N)

If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Develop prompt engineering strategies, implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and optimize model inference latency and cost
Develop and champion modern software development best practices and concepts to technical audience and business stakeholders.
Lead cross functional teams to develop and deploy production quality code for clients.
Lead full software development life cycle execution including architecture design, writing documentation and unit/integration tests, identifying issues and resolution, writing clean code, conducting code reviews, and mentoring other Engineers.

Provide technical guidance to external clients and internal stakeholders in Bain (80%): 

Drive AI-led or AI-assisted transformation to improve productivity and quality across the PDLC  
Explore new innovations in AI and software development to further improve productivity and modularity.
Mentor and coach engineering teams on technology stack best practices and operational models to raise their software engineering capabilities.
Lead ideation processes, alongside consulting and client colleagues, to bring innovative solutions to problems.
Drive engagements that help to understand current state of clients’ architecture, micro-services, build processes, and security needs.
Lead in a collaborative manner with clients’ technical teams to define technical approaches to implementing designed solutions, including new product architecture, data flows and integration strategies, and build processes.

Scope, architect, design, develop, build, and release robust and scalable applications (20%):

Translate business requirements into technical requirements and implementation details Lead development of complex systems that are extensible, easy to understand, and self-maintaining.
Design integrations with third-party systems to enable use cases that power business solutions.

Work closely with product and design to create modern AI systems. Architect and design end-to-end AI agent systems, including reasoning loops, planning mechanisms, and tool orchestration frameworks
Develop and optimize LLM-powered applications using advanced prompting, structured outputs, and model routing strategies
Design and implement multi-agent architectures (planner, executor, verifier, critic patterns)
Architect and build scalable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with optimized embedding and retrieval strategies

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for someone who has:

Bachelor’s in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent work experience.
Experience in an engineering role at a start-up or fast-growing tech company, with a strong track record of increasing mastery and responsibility.
10+ years of experience with full-stack development.
6+ years of experience with micro-service API development (e.g., RESTful, GraphQL, gRPC) with frameworks (e.g. FastAPI, Swagger, OpenAPI etc.).
4+ years of experience in consulting.
2+ years of experience leading or managing development teams
1+ years of experience with AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
Strong knowledge in development best practices (automated testing frameworks, CI/CD etc.).
Strong computer science fundaments in data structures, algorithms, automated testing, object-oriented programming, performance complexity, and implications of computer architecture on software performance.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills,
Deep understanding of large language models (LLMs) and transformer architectures
Strong knowledge of prompt engineering, structured prompting, and reasoning control techniques
Experience designing and deploying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems
Ability to evaluate model performance beyond accuracy (reasoning quality, hallucination rate, task success)

Strong Python proficiency for AI development

enior Manager – TS AI Finance Engineering
to be located in New Brunswick or Raritan, NJ.

This role leads the development and adoption of AI-powered software engineering capabilities across Finance Technology through the SigniFi platform. This role is responsible for driving AI-enabled SDLC transformation, accelerating delivery, improving quality, and scaling reusable AI solutions across SAP Finance and enterprise applications. Increased adoption of AI engineering capabilities across Finance Technology.
Improved software delivery speed, quality, and productivity.

High stakeholder satisfaction and successful delivery of strategic AI initiatives.
Development of a high-performing, innovative engineering organization.

This role is instrumental in transforming Finance Technology from traditional software development to an AI-first engineering organization. Lead a portfolio of diverse technology projects and a team of developers with deep experience in distributed microservices, and full stack systems to create solutions that help meet regulatory needs for the company
Share your passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal & external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community, and from time to time, be asked to code or evaluate code

9+ years of experience in at least one of the following: JavaScript, Java, TypeScript, SQL, Python, or Go

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Automation Engineering-Strategy & Analytics
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...The Drone Delivery team is seeking a Senior Manager, Strategy & Analytics to lead the evolution of data-driven expansion strategy across Walmart’s drone delivery network. This role will own the analytics, market intelligence, and strategic planning capabilities that inform where and how the business expands. You will lead the development of scalable frameworks for market and site selection, leveraging operational, customer, geographic, financial, and partner data to guide expansion decisions. This role will also drive continuous optimization of expansion strategy by evaluating network performance, identifying improvement opportunities, and advancing AI-enabled decision-making capabilities that improve market selection and long-range planning at scale. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical depth with strategic thinking, executive communication skills, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. What You’ll Do Market & Site Selection Strategy

Lead the development and execution of data-driven market and site selection strategies for drone delivery expansion.
Build and continuously refine scalable frameworks that evaluate expansion opportunities using operational, demographic, customer, geographic, financial, and regulatory data.
Partner cross-functionally to validate and vet proposed expansion markets and site opportunities.

Expansion Analytics, Strategy & Planning

Develop insights and feedback loops that continuously optimize market prioritization, launch sequencing, network performance, and expansion decision-making.
Lead the evolution of advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools that improve market selection, network planning, and expansion decision-making at scale.
Support long-range planning, network scaling, and expansion prioritization activities through strategic analyses and scenario planning.
Identify new data sources, analytical methodologies, and predictive indicators that strengthen expansion strategy and network performance.
Develop strategic recommendations related to growth strategy, market prioritization, and portfolio optimization.

Executive Insights & Cross-Functional Leadership

Translate complex analyses into clear, compelling narratives that support executive decision-making.
Develop dashboards, visualizations, and strategic presentations that communicate expansion performance, risks, opportunities, and recommendations.
Partner across operations, product, finance, engineering, real estate, permitting, and external vendors to drive alignment and execution across expansion initiatives.

What You’ll Bring

6+ years of experience in strategy, analytics, business intelligence, operations strategy, network planning, or related fields
Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with experience translating complex business challenges into scalable solutions
Experience developing strategic models, forecasts, scenario analyses, and executive-facing business insights
Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment in highly matrixed environments
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex analyses into actionable recommendations
Experience in logistics, retail, transportation, marketplace operations, network strategy, or technology-enabled operations preferred

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Engineering, Business, Economics, Supply Chain, Data Science, Finance, or related field and 5 years’ experience in analytics, strategy, operations, or related area OR 7 years’ experience in analytics, strategy, operations, or related area.
5+ years of experience using data and analytics to influence strategic or operational decision-making.
Experience with SQL, Python, or similar analytical tools and technologies.
Experience developing executive-level reporting, dashboards, or business insights.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Business, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Economics, or related field
Experience supporting network expansion, site selection, geographic analysis, or strategic planning initiatives
Experience working with AI/ML-enabled decision systems or predictive modeling capabilities
Experience in autonomous delivery, logistics, retail operations, marketplace expansion, or transportation strategy
Experience working in highly cross-functional, matrixed organizations

At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.

Elite is the trusted automation platform for law firm operations across most of the world’s largest and most successful law firms. Elite has guided firms through every technology shift and today delivers the only cloud-native SaaS platform that unifies financial, invoice, time, and data management into a single system of action. With embedded AI, predictive analytics, and integrated payments, Elite’s products enable firms to shorten billing cycles, reduce write-offs, and unlock firm-wide insights, making financial operations the foundation for law firm innovation and growth. Learn more at elite.com.
Position Overview

Elite is hiring a Director , Platform & Intelligence Value Stream to own the value stream end to end — the shared platform foundation every Elite product is built on, together with the productization of our AI and data capabilities. You will own the roadmap for orchestration, conversational AI, rules, unified access, and the event backbone, and turn those services into a reusable foundation that our financial, work-to-cash, and internal business product lines build on rather than around.  
This is both a strategy role and a delivery role. You will carry the what and why for the stream — a single prioritized backlog, roadmap sequencing, and requirements translation through release commitment and delivery — pair daily with an engineering delivery unit, and lead a small standing team of domain and analyst talent. Because the platform is horizontal, you will sit upstream of every customer-facing product line, and you will be measured on the return the stream delivers rather than on output volume.  
Work Arrangement:
​ Remote ​  
Responsibilities

Own the Platform & Framework Foundation

Own the product roadmap for Elite's shared platform services — including workflow orchestration, conversational AI, and business rules — and sequence their maturity from foundation to scale.
Own the product direction for unified access and entitlements — authorization, user management, data-level security, and subscription-driven feature access across Elite applications.
Treat the platform as a product with internal customers, defining the patterns, contracts, and adoption paths by which other product teams consume shared services, so capability is built once and reused.
Partner with Engineering on the shared infrastructure and sequencing that let product teams build on the platform rather than around it.  

Productize AI & Data

Own productization of workflow- and agent-driven capabilities that move customers beyond traditional reporting toward AI that takes action inside their day-to-day financial and legal workflows.
Turn data assets into productized offerings on a modern cloud data platform, with clear value metrics and pricing.
Shape product and go-to-market strategy for integrations that give customers richer, real-time access to their data, including through third-party AI tools.  

Lead the Value Stream

Define and prioritize a single backlog around customer outcomes and return on investment, and drive it from backlog through release commitment and delivery.
Set quarterly outcomes for the stream and point the paired delivery unit at the highest-value work; own feasibility, trade-offs, escalations, and backlog readiness.
Lead and grow the stream's standing team of domain and analyst talent, raising the bar on domain depth and AI fluency.
Act as the product voice in architectural and platform prioritization, steering infrastructure investment toward the capabilities that drive customer outcomes and revenue.  

Build Governance In from the Start

Partner with Security and Architecture from the outset of each initiative to build data governance, access control, auditability, and appropriate safeguards into agentic products and integrations that handle privileged and financial data.
Ensure agents inherit user-level permissions, including data-level security, so intelligence and automation stay within firm entitlements by design.

Enable Sales and Services with clear narratives, value propositions, and routing guidance for platform, AI, and data capabilities.

What You'll Do

Avalara is building the Agentic Content Studio Platform (ACSP), a next-generation platform designed to improve how global tax and compliance content is sourced, maintained, validated, and consumed across the business.

The Director of Engineering, Agentic Content Engineering, will lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of Agentic Content Studio Platform. This platform will support expansion into new content domains including VAT Advanced Sections, Registration, Business Licenses, XBorder Marketplace, and Communications, while also improving the efficiency and scalability of existing content operations through automation and AI-assisted workflows.

This role combines platform engineering, applied AI, workflow automation, and organizational leadership. Success in this role requires balancing technical innovation with operational rigor, measurable business outcomes, platform reliability, and responsible AI adoption.

The platform is expected to improve content scalability, accelerate onboarding of new content domains, reduce manual research effort, and enable content teams to operate through AI-assisted and human-reviewed workflows.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Define and execute the engineering vision, architecture, and delivery roadmap for the Agentic Content Studio Platform.
Build scalable platform capabilities that support onboarding and maintenance of global compliance content across multiple domains.
Lead development of AI-assisted workflows that automate sourcing, extraction, transformation, validation, and maintenance of content.
Establish reliable human-in-the-loop operating models that combine AI-driven automation with researcher review and oversight.
Design secure, observable, and resilient platform services spanning orchestration, APIs, workflow automation, integrations, and content systems.
Enable downstream products and services such as AvaTax, ATC, and ATR to interact with platform capabilities through modern integration interfaces, including MCP where appropriate.
Define measurable engineering and operational metrics tied to platform reliability, quality, productivity, adoption, and business impact.
Partner closely with Product, Content Research, Applied AI, Architecture, and business stakeholders to align platform investments with company priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization with strong technical depth, accountability, and execution discipline.
Drive pragmatic adoption of AI across engineering workflows, planning, delivery operations, observability, and decision-making processes.
Ensure governance, security, and responsible AI practices are incorporated into platform design and operational processes.

12-Month Success Outcomes

Deliver and operationalize a clear ACSP platform roadmap aligned to Avalara’s content expansion and productivity objectives.
Launch foundational platform capabilities supporting the first wave of new content domains and workflow automation initiatives.
Deliver production-ready AI-assisted workflows for sourcing and extracting international lodging content in targeted countries.
Deliver scalable workflows supporting generation and maintenance of VAT advanced section content across multiple countries.
Improve operational efficiency by reducing manual content research and maintenance effort through automation and reviewer-assisted workflows.
Establish reliable production integrations enabling downstream systems to consume platform capabilities through standardized interfaces.
Implement measurable operational metrics for reliability, automation coverage, quality, cycle time, and platform adoption.
Build a strong engineering leadership team with clear ownership, high accountability, and strong execution standards.

Applied AI Expectations

Apply AI to improve automation, scalability, quality, and operational efficiency.
Design agent-based workflows capable of coordinating multi-step content tasks with appropriate escalation and human review mechanisms.
Leverage AI to improve engineering execution, planning, observability, and operational workflows.
Drive adoption of AI capabilities as part of core platform functionality and engineering operations rather than isolated experimentation.
Ensure responsible use of AI through governance, transparency, monitoring, and risk controls.
Raise engineering team capability through coaching, standards, and practical implementation guidance.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
12+ years of software engineering experience, including large-scale platforms or distributed systems.
5+ years of experience leading engineering managers and senior engineers in complex cross-functional organizations.
Proven experience leading platform strategy, architecture, and execution with measurable business outcomes.
Experience applying AI and automation to improve operational scale, quality, productivity, or customer impact.
Strong experience with distributed systems, APIs, workflow orchestration, integrations, and event-driven architectures.
Experience building platforms that support automation, operational observability, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to align engineering investments to business priorities.
Excellent execution rigor, technical judgment, communication skills, and organizational leadership.

Technical Expertise

Experience with LLMs, agent-based systems, RAG architectures, or equivalent AI platforms.
Strong engineering background in Python and modern AI application frameworks.
Experience building cloud-native systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, and model lifecycle management.
Strong platform and systems design experience focused on reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.

Leadership Characteristics

Demonstrated ability to build and mentor high-performing engineering organizations.
Strong product and platform mindset with a focus on customer and business outcomes.
Ability to communicate effectively with senior technical and executive stakeholders.
Pragmatic, execution-oriented leader capable of operating strategically while remaining technically engaged.

What Makes This a Bar-Raiser Role

AI Bar Raiser

At Avalara, this role is expected to be an AI Bar Raiser — a leader who elevates both the technical capability of the organization and the practical application of AI across engineering and operational workflows.

This individual is expected to apply advanced AI capabilities to materially improve how systems are designed, built, operated, and scaled, while driving measurable gains in engineering productivity, quality, automation, and business impact. The expectation is to create a culture of 10x productivity through the effective use of AI tools, modern engineering technologies, automation, and an agile execution mindset where speed is table stakes.

Bar Raiser

At Avalara, this role is expected to be a Bar Raiser who strengthens teams by improving technical judgment, accelerating organizational learning, mentoring engineers and leaders, and leaving platforms, processes, and operating models significantly better than they found them.

This role is expected to redefine how engineering, AI, and content operations work together at scale across Avalara.
Success requires building not only a technically strong platform, but also a durable operating model that improves execution speed, quality, scalability, and business impact.
The leader in this role must consistently raise the bar across architecture, engineering discipline, AI adoption, operational excellence, talent density, and cross-functional execution.
The ideal candidate combines deep technical judgment with strong organizational leadership and has a demonstrated track record of delivering complex platform transformations with measurable outcomes.
This is a highly visible leadership role with direct influence on Avalara’s AI strategy, content scalability, and long-term operational efficiency.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

The mission of the Platforms and Devices (P&D) team in gUP is to support users (end users, partners, small businesses, etc.) for Google’s consumer products and services such as Pixel, Google Fi, Home and Health, Google Store, Google subscriptions as well as Google Store.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. We’re looking for a strategic and technically strong engineering leader to drive innovation and scale for one of Avalara's flagship SaaS products—a $50M revenue-generating line with double-digit growth and a customer base in the hundreds of thousands. Lead and inspire engineering teams through a multi-year transformation, including replatforming legacy components and building modern, scalable infrastructure.

A track record of building and mentoring high-performing teams, with a leadership style that’s both empowering and execution-focused.
Clear, strategic communication—comfortable engaging across technical, product, and business teams.

This Role Is For You If…

You're an engineering leader ready to scale something meaningful, not just maintain the status quo.
You see AI as a tool for product differentiation—not just a buzzword—and know how to apply it with intent.
You thrive in high-impact environments where visibility is high and the opportunity to influence is even higher.

AI Bar Raiser

This individual is expected to apply advanced AI capabilities to materially improve how systems are designed, built, operated, and scaled, while driving measurable gains in engineering productivity, quality, automation, and business impact. The expectation is to create a culture of 10x productivity through the effective use of AI tools, modern engineering technologies, automation, and an agile execution mindset where speed is table stakes.

Bar Raiser

At Avalara, this role is expected to be a Bar Raiser who strengthens teams by improving technical judgment, accelerating organizational learning, mentoring engineers and leaders, and leaving platforms, processes, and operating models significantly better than they found them.

This role is expected to redefine how engineering, AI, and content operations work together at scale across Avalara.
Success requires building not only a technically strong platform, but also a durable operating model that improves execution speed, quality, scalability, and business impact.
The leader in this role must consistently raise the bar across architecture, engineering discipline, AI adoption, operational excellence, talent density, and cross-functional execution.
The ideal candidate combines deep technical judgment with strong organizational leadership and has a demonstrated track record of delivering complex platform transformations with measurable outcomes.

You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

Deep CBTC and rail signaling expertise with 10+ years of experience designing, integrating, testing, and deploying Communications-Based Train Control (CBTC) and train control systems within metro, transit, or rail infrastructure environments.

Experience delivering CBTC projects for major transit agencies and/or prior experience with Siemens Mobility, Alstom, Hitachi Rail, Thales, Wabtec, Bombardier Transportation, Ansaldo STS, or similar rail signaling organizations is highly preferred.

new_jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

We’re transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization.

Collectors is committed to utilize cybersecurity, risk and privacy best practices on our platforms, leveraging signal intelligence and observability at scale to protect our customers, employees and our brand. We’re looking for a Director of Internal Platforms and Developer Experience to join our Platform Engineering team to partner with the broader Product and Tech org and build the foundational systems that our engineers rely on to build, deploy and run our applications.

You’ll report to the VP of Engineering, Information Security and Platforms. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.

What You’ll Do

Define and drive the platform engineering strategy across infrastructure, developer experience, and AI enablement, ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals and technology roadmaps.
Lead and develop multiple engineering teams responsible for core infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, cloud services, and the internal developer platform, fostering a culture of reliability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Own the vision for developer experience, ensuring internal teams have access to well-documented, self-service tooling and platforms that reduce friction and accelerate the path from code to production.
Establish and oversee AI enablement strategies, including the evaluation, integration, and governance of AI-assisted development tools and frameworks, ensuring teams can adopt AI capabilities responsibly and effectively.
Define guardrails and governance frameworks for AI adoption, partnering with security, legal, and compliance stakeholders to create policies that balance innovation velocity with risk management, data privacy, and responsible use.
Set standards for platform reliability, scalability, and security, driving investment in observability, incident response, infrastructure-as-code, and capacity planning to support the organization's growth.
Partner cross-functionally with product engineering, security, data, and architecture leaders to ensure platform capabilities meet current and emerging needs across the organization.
Champion a platform-as-a-product mindset, using internal feedback loops, adoption metrics, and developer satisfaction data to continuously iterate on the platforms and services your teams provide.

Who You Are

A seasoned engineering leader with 10+ years of experience in software or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years managing engineering teams and at least 2+ years leading managers or multiple teams simultaneously.
Deeply technical with a strategic mindset. You've built or scaled platform and infrastructure organizations and can move fluidly between architectural decisions and organizational strategy without losing sight of either.
An expert in modern infrastructure and platform tooling, with hands-on experience across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container orchestration (k8s), CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), infrastructure-as-code (Terrafor/Crossplane), and observability stacks.
A champion of developer experience. You've operated with a platform-as-a-product philosophy, and you have a track record of building internal tooling and self-service platforms that measurably improve developer productivity and satisfaction.
Fluent in the AI-assisted development landscape. You understand the current ecosystem of AI coding assistants, code generation tools, and LLM-based development frameworks, and you've led or contributed to organizational strategies for adopting them thoughtfully.
Governance-minded without being risk-averse. You know how to design guardrails and policies around emerging technology — particularly AI — that protect the organization without stifling innovation, and you're comfortable partnering with security, legal, and compliance teams to get there.
A strong cross-functional partner. You build trust easily with product engineering, architecture, security, and business stakeholders, and you're skilled at translating platform capabilities into business value.
Operationally excellent. You've managed cloud infrastructure budgets, vendor relationships, and capacity planning at scale, and you bring a disciplined approach to headcount planning and resource allocation.
An effective communicator who can articulate platform strategy and technical trade-offs to audiences ranging from individual contributors to executive leadership with equal clarity.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $212,000- $300,000. Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation, please ask your recruiter for details.

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and lead complex projects.

About The Job

In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more).

The mission of the Platforms and Devices (P&D) team in gUP is to support users (end users, partners, small businesses, etc.) for Google’s consumer products and services such as Pixel, Google Fi, Home and Health, Google Store, Google subscriptions as well as Google Store.

As the Head of gUP P&D for Google Store Product and Customer Support Excellence, you will lead a high-performing team of Product Support Managers and assist cross-functional effort. You are responsible for delivering a customer support experience for the Google Store, spanning online and a growing network of offline, primarily hardware, retail with a global footprint. You will act as a strategic consultant to the Google Store Product area, translating complex user feedback and friction points into actionable insights that shape the future of the Store portions of the Pixel ecosystem, Store product roadmaps and customer support strategies. Your mission is to advocate customer trust, mitigate fraud, and scale support operations through innovative AI and automation.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video .

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $224000 - $311000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Define and execute end-to-end operational frameworks for Google Store to deliver a consistent customer experience, enhance user trust, and reduce fraud while driving cost efficiency worldwide.
Implement next-generation machine learning and AI conversational support systems to automate user interactions, streamline workflows, and significantly decrease global contact rates across operations.
Synthesize customer feedback to resolve critical journey gaps, manage bug hotlists, and guarantee complete operational readiness while exceeding core launch metrics.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and UX to advocate for customer-centric post-purchase features across the lifecycle while ensuring compliance with complex regulations.
Inspire and mentor Product Support Managers to foster a high-impact culture while managing strategic relationships with executive stakeholders across Store product, operations, and global support teams.

new_jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

At Lilly, Synthetic Molecule Design and Development (SMDD) is involved in key activities for the development of synthetic active pharmaceutical ingredients from pre-clinical phases through commercialization of drug substances and drug products. Our scientists and engineers develop key technical and business solutions across the portfolio using their deep technical expertise to accelerate testing of the clinical hypothesis and overall drug development. SMDD delivers on these responsibilities by recognizing diverse talent and cultures are necessary to bring the next generation of life changing medicines to patients.

Position Summary

Our team is looking for experienced, creative, and energetic candidates to lead unit operation development and process optimization of synthetic drug candidates to support clinical trials, regulatory submission, and product commercialization. The position presents an opportunity to lead dynamic teams comprised of process chemists, analytical chemists, formulation scientists, and engineers.

Responsibilities

Possess fluent knowledge in unit operation design, process modeling, process equipment selection, and scale-up methodologies with a drive to challenge existing methods; create and apply cutting edge technology and novel platforms within a time constrained environment.
Familiarity and working knowledge of modern synthetic organic chemistry.
Demonstrate high learning agility with the ability to understand and exploit new scientific concepts and methods across multiple disciplines; be able to apply these learnings to a portfolio of small molecule, oligonucleotide, and synthetic peptide modalities.
Lead and/or supervise the design and development of new synthetic routes for the manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredients using the most modern technologies, including continuous processing, automated reaction screening, PAT, and modeling and simulation.
Ability to lead a cross-disciplinary team to evaluate and refine new manufacturing routes, manufacturing technologies, and practices to deliver a challenging portfolio.
Comfortable with scientific uncertainty and the ability to translate hypotheses into action.
Encourage team members to take initiative and accountability to achieve goals; draws out and encourages others to share knowledge.
Provide technical guidance in the scale-up and demonstration of new chemical processes in development and commercial scale equipment. Participate in technology transfer activities to CRO/CMO organizations and Lilly manufacturing to ensure processes are technically sound, well developed and characterized, and safe.
Design laboratory experimentation in support of process design, definition, optimization, and technology transfer objectives. Ability to generate process (and property design) data based on a fundamental understanding of the underlying physical processes. Utilize advancements in technology (PAT) and modeling platforms to understand and direct experimental protocols.
Plan and manage short term and long-term development activities. Develop and/or review technical agendas and timelines for project work. Recommend resource allocation to accomplish projects according to plans, communicate progress and propose changes in timeline, objectives, or direction.
Collaborate with internal and external manufacturing partners to develop robust chemical process that are readily amenable to efficient drug substance manufacturing.
Collaborate closely with Product Delivery, Project Management, Quality, Manufacturing, and Regulatory scientists to execute and deliver material and information for clinical trials and regulatory submissions.
Embrace diverse thought, background, and experience to deliver innovative solutions.
Possess strong communication (oral, written), organizational, and leadership skills.
Supervise, mentor and develop scientific staff. Ensure continued technical and professional growth of group members, encourage efforts towards excellence and knowledge sharing.
Active participant in the external environment and the ability to recognize and apply external innovation and across the Lilly synthetic portfolio.
Possess deep understanding of the external global regulatory climate and emerging requirements. Ability to address key CMC regulatory questions that enable clinical studies and support marketing authorization applications.

Ph.D. in chemical engineering or a closely related field with 8+ years of experience; or MS degree with 15+ years of experience.
Experience developing chemical processes the from mid-development cycle (proof of concept) to product commercialization required
Experience with technical transfer of processes into manufacturing operations required
Experience within the pharmaceutical sector is desired; however, other relevant experience may meet expectations. Prior experience in the development of an active ingredient and associated formulated product is acceptable. Relevant industrial sectors include agrochemicals, nutraceuticals, specialty chemicals, and personal care products.

Additional Skills/Preferences

Experience with authoring regulatory submissions and responding to regulatory questions.
Experience with modeling and simulation tools, data analytics, and predictive analytics.
Experience with online and offline analytical techniques and process analytical technologies (PAT).
Strong technical skills to supply business value.
Creativity and ability to transform ideas into marketable products and processes.
Knowledge and experience with management of a technical project.
Demonstrated leadership capabilities especially in a team environment.
Demonstrated ability to drive and accept change.
Demonstrated success in persuasion, influence and negotiation.
Good interpersonal skills and a sustained tendency for collaboration.
Ability to prioritize multiple activities and manage ambiguity.
Ability to influence others to promote a positive work environment.
Understanding and awareness of the external scientific and regulatory landscape.
Demonstrated initiative and risk-taking.
Demonstrated technical proficiency and ability to create ideas for future work plans.
Established external publication record.

Experience working with AI/ML-enabled decision systems or predictive modeling capabilities

new_jobs.title: Director, Platform and Intelligence Value Stream
new_jobs.description:
Elite is the trusted automation platform for law firm operations across most of the world’s largest and most successful law firms. Elite has guided firms through every technology shift and today delivers the only cloud-native SaaS platform that unifies financial, invoice, time, and data management into a single system of action. With embedded AI, predictive analytics, and integrated payments, Elite’s products enable firms to shorten billing cycles, reduce write-offs, and unlock firm-wide insights, making financial operations the foundation for law firm innovation and growth. Learn more at elite.com.
Position Overview

Elite is hiring a Director , Platform & Intelligence Value Stream to own the value stream end to end — the shared platform foundation every Elite product is built on, together with the productization of our AI and data capabilities. You will own the roadmap for orchestration, conversational AI, rules, unified access, and the event backbone, and turn those services into a reusable foundation that our financial, work-to-cash, and internal business product lines build on rather than around.  
This is both a strategy role and a delivery role. You will carry the what and why for the stream — a single prioritized backlog, roadmap sequencing, and requirements translation through release commitment and delivery — pair daily with an engineering delivery unit, and lead a small standing team of domain and analyst talent. Because the platform is horizontal, you will sit upstream of every customer-facing product line, and you will be measured on the return the stream delivers rather than on output volume.  
Work Arrangement:
​ Remote ​  
Responsibilities

Own the Platform & Framework Foundation

Own the product roadmap for Elite's shared platform services — including workflow orchestration, conversational AI, and business rules — and sequence their maturity from foundation to scale.
Own the product direction for unified access and entitlements — authorization, user management, data-level security, and subscription-driven feature access across Elite applications.
Treat the platform as a product with internal customers, defining the patterns, contracts, and adoption paths by which other product teams consume shared services, so capability is built once and reused.
Partner with Engineering on the shared infrastructure and sequencing that let product teams build on the platform rather than around it.  

Productize AI & Data

Own productization of workflow- and agent-driven capabilities that move customers beyond traditional reporting toward AI that takes action inside their day-to-day financial and legal workflows.
Turn data assets into productized offerings on a modern cloud data platform, with clear value metrics and pricing.
Shape product and go-to-market strategy for integrations that give customers richer, real-time access to their data, including through third-party AI tools.  

Lead the Value Stream

Define and prioritize a single backlog around customer outcomes and return on investment, and drive it from backlog through release commitment and delivery.
Set quarterly outcomes for the stream and point the paired delivery unit at the highest-value work; own feasibility, trade-offs, escalations, and backlog readiness.
Lead and grow the stream's standing team of domain and analyst talent, raising the bar on domain depth and AI fluency.
Act as the product voice in architectural and platform prioritization, steering infrastructure investment toward the capabilities that drive customer outcomes and revenue.  

Build Governance In from the Start

Partner with Security and Architecture from the outset of each initiative to build data governance, access control, auditability, and appropriate safeguards into agentic products and integrations that handle privileged and financial data.
Ensure agents inherit user-level permissions, including data-level security, so intelligence and automation stay within firm entitlements by design.  

Commercialize and Enable

Define value metrics and commercial models that make return on investment legible to customers and to the business.
Enable Sales and Services with clear narratives, value propositions, and routing guidance for platform, AI, and data capabilities.
Use usage data, customer insight, and financial metrics to drive prioritization for adoption, retention, and revenue impact.
Perform other duties as assigned to support departmental and company objectives. ​  

Qualifications  

​ ​ Bachelor's Degree ​ or equivalent education and experience.
10+ years in product management, including direct ownership of platform, data, analytics, or AI/ML products, with at least three years leading product managers or end-to-end delivery.
Demonstrated experience productizing AI/ML or agentic capabilities into shipped B2B products — not only analytics or BI reporting. This is a core requirement.
Hands-on experience productizing platform or foundational services — workflow and orchestration, identity and entitlements, rules engines, or shared data services — consumed by multiple product teams.
Experience building or productizing data offerings on a modern cloud data platform or lakehouse architecture (for example Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake), with the technical fluency to make sound build trade-offs.
Experience packaging, pricing, and commercializing data products or platform integrations, including connectors or APIs that expose data to third-party tools or AI assistants.
Direct experience with data governance, access control, or compliance in a regulated or sensitive-data setting, and comfort partnering closely with Security and Architecture.
A track record of end-to-end delivery ownership — turning strategy into measurable, shipped outcomes — with fluency in backlog management and outcome metrics.
Proven people leadership: hiring, developing, and directing product and analyst talent, and leading through influence across Engineering and business partners.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management, with a bias toward focus, prioritization, and measurable outcomes.
Experience building or operating complex B2B SaaS platforms in ERP, financial systems, legal technology, or another regulated environment, preferred.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps or comparable backlog and delivery tooling, preferred.
Ability to travel up  ​

Retirement Savings Plan with an Employer Contribution
Professional Development Opportunities
Time Off

In our flexible remote approach, you have the freedom to choose a workspace within your home country that best fits your needs. What You'll Do

Avalara is building the Agentic Content Studio Platform (ACSP), a next-generation platform designed to improve how global tax and compliance content is sourced, maintained, validated, and consumed across the business.

The Director of Engineering, Agentic Content Engineering, will lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of Agentic Content Studio Platform. This platform will support expansion into new content domains including VAT Advanced Sections, Registration, Business Licenses, XBorder Marketplace, and Communications, while also improving the efficiency and scalability of existing content operations through automation and AI-assisted workflows.

This role combines platform engineering, applied AI, workflow automation, and organizational leadership. Success in this role requires balancing technical innovation with operational rigor, measurable business outcomes, platform reliability, and responsible AI adoption.

The platform is expected to improve content scalability, accelerate onboarding of new content domains, reduce manual research effort, and enable content teams to operate through AI-assisted and human-reviewed workflows.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Define and execute the engineering vision, architecture, and delivery roadmap for the Agentic Content Studio Platform.
Build scalable platform capabilities that support onboarding and maintenance of global compliance content across multiple domains.
Lead development of AI-assisted workflows that automate sourcing, extraction, transformation, validation, and maintenance of content.
Establish reliable human-in-the-loop operating models that combine AI-driven automation with researcher review and oversight.
Design secure, observable, and resilient platform services spanning orchestration, APIs, workflow automation, integrations, and content systems.
Enable downstream products and services such as AvaTax, ATC, and ATR to interact with platform capabilities through modern integration interfaces, including MCP where appropriate.
Define measurable engineering and operational metrics tied to platform reliability, quality, productivity, adoption, and business impact.
Partner closely with Product, Content Research, Applied AI, Architecture, and business stakeholders to align platform investments with company priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization with strong technical depth, accountability, and execution discipline.
Drive pragmatic adoption of AI across engineering workflows, planning, delivery operations, observability, and decision-making processes.
Ensure governance, security, and responsible AI practices are incorporated into platform design and operational processes.

12-Month Success Outcomes

Deliver and operationalize a clear ACSP platform roadmap aligned to Avalara’s content expansion and productivity objectives.
Launch foundational platform capabilities supporting the first wave of new content domains and workflow automation initiatives.
Deliver production-ready AI-assisted workflows for sourcing and extracting international lodging content in targeted countries.
Deliver scalable workflows supporting generation and maintenance of VAT advanced section content across multiple countries.
Improve operational efficiency by reducing manual content research and maintenance effort through automation and reviewer-assisted workflows.
Establish reliable production integrations enabling downstream systems to consume platform capabilities through standardized interfaces.
Implement measurable operational metrics for reliability, automation coverage, quality, cycle time, and platform adoption.

In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Bain’s Vector leads the firm’s software development efforts and defines engineering standards for Bain globally.

You will collaborate with diverse product and engineering teams to build help engineering organizations transform across people, process, and technology to support business needs for both consumer and enterprise environments.
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Drive client improvements in AI-assisted or AI-led maturity across people, process, and technology. 
Mentor and coach developers to improve productivity through adoption of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex etc.)
Lead in designing, developing, and documenting AI applications aligned to business outcomes.
Develop prompt engineering strategies, implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and optimize model inference latency and cost
Develop and champion modern software development best practices and concepts to technical audience and business stakeholders.
Lead cross functional teams to develop and deploy production quality code for clients.
Lead full software development life cycle execution including architecture design, writing documentation and unit/integration tests, identifying issues and resolution, writing clean code, conducting code reviews, and mentoring other Engineers.

Provide technical guidance to external clients and internal stakeholders in Bain (80%): 

Drive AI-led or AI-assisted transformation to improve productivity and quality across the PDLC  
Explore new innovations in AI and software development to further improve productivity and modularity.
Mentor and coach engineering teams on technology stack best practices and operational models to raise their software engineering capabilities.
Lead ideation processes, alongside consulting and client colleagues, to bring innovative solutions to problems.
Drive engagements that help to understand current state of clients’ architecture, micro-services, build processes, and security needs.
Lead in a collaborative manner with clients’ technical teams to define technical approaches to implementing designed solutions, including new product architecture, data flows and integration strategies, and build processes.

Scope, architect, design, develop, build, and release robust and scalable applications (20%):

Translate business requirements into technical requirements and implementation details Lead development of complex systems that are extensible, easy to understand, and self-maintaining.
Design integrations with third-party systems to enable use cases that power business solutions.

Work closely with product and design to create modern AI systems. Architect and design end-to-end AI agent systems, including reasoning loops, planning mechanisms, and tool orchestration frameworks
Develop and optimize LLM-powered applications using advanced prompting, structured outputs, and model routing strategies
Design and implement multi-agent architectures (planner, executor, verifier, critic patterns)
Architect and build scalable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with optimized embedding and retrieval strategies

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for someone who has:

Bachelor’s in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent work experience.
Experience in an engineering role at a start-up or fast-growing tech company, with a strong track record of increasing mastery and responsibility.
10+ years of experience with full-stack development.
6+ years of experience with micro-service API development (e.g., RESTful, GraphQL, gRPC) with frameworks (e.g. FastAPI, Swagger, OpenAPI etc.).
4+ years of experience in consulting.
2+ years of experience leading or managing development teams
1+ years of experience with AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
Strong knowledge in development best practices (automated testing frameworks, CI/CD etc.).
Strong computer science fundaments in data structures, algorithms, automated testing, object-oriented programming, performance complexity, and implications of computer architecture on software performance.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills,
Deep understanding of large language models (LLMs) and transformer architectures
Strong knowledge of prompt engineering, structured prompting, and reasoning control techniques
Experience designing and deploying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems
Ability to evaluate model performance beyond accuracy (reasoning quality, hallucination rate, task success)
Understanding of tokenization, context window limits, and cost optimization strategies
Strong Python proficiency for AI development

Ideal candidates will also have experience in:

Master’s in computer science or a related technical field.
Experience working with or providing services to enterprise customers (Fortune 500, Global 1000).
Experience working on public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and associated deep understanding of failover, high-availability, and high scalability.
Ability to explain and discuss technical concepts and methodologies with colleagues and clients from other disciplines.
This role follows a hybrid model, requiring in-office presence at least 3 days per week, either at a client location or at your Bain home office
Travel is required (~25%)

Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).

In Atlanta, Boston, Texas, and Chicago the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary for this role is $258,425

Placement within these ranges will vary based on factors such as experience, education, training, and skill level.
Compensation also includes a discretionary annual performance bonus, 401(k) plan with employer contribution, and Bain’s best-in-class benefits—including full premium coverage for medical, dental, and vision, generous paid time off, and more.

Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays

new_jobs.title: Sr Manager, Communications-Based Train Control Technical Manager- Rail Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
Pioneering in America, from the first mile to the last. This is what drives us.

We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® certified—a reflection of our commitment to creating an environment where innovation thrives, and every voice matters. Apply today and be part of shaping the future with us!

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here:
https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

Position Overview:

Siemens Mobility is seeking a highly experienced Senior CBTC Technical Manager to serve as the technical authority for Communications-Based Train Control (CBTC) systems on complex transit and rail infrastructure projects. This role is ideal for a seasoned CBTC professional with expertise in system architecture, systems integration, requirements management, testing and commissioning, and customer-facing technical leadership.

As the project's CBTC technical lead, you will be responsible for guiding system design, integration, validation, migration, and change management activities while serving as the primary technical interface between Siemens, customers, and key project stakeholders.

What your day may look like:

Serve as the technical authority for CBTC systems, leading system architecture, requirements management, subsystem integration, and technical decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.
Act as the customer's trusted technical advisor, driving technical discussions, resolving complex system-level issues, and ensuring solutions align with operational, contractual, and performance requirements.
Lead multidisciplinary systems engineering and integration teams across signaling, train control, communications, cybersecurity, and safety disciplines to deliver complex rail infrastructure projects.
Oversee end-to-end CBTC integration, verification & validation, testing, migration, commissioning, and revenue service implementation, ensuring successful deployment of safety-critical train control systems.
Drive technical governance and project success by leading change control activities, managing technical risks, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and providing strategic technical guidance to project leadership and customers.

This posting outlines the primary responsibilities of the role, but is not all-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned in alignment with business needs.

To thrive in this role, you have:

Deep CBTC and rail signaling expertise with 10+ years of experience designing, integrating, testing, and deploying Communications-Based Train Control (CBTC) and train control systems within metro, transit, or rail infrastructure environments.
Proven technical leadership experience serving as a CBTC Technical Manager, Systems Engineering Manager, Lead Systems Engineer, Integration Manager, or similar role, with responsibility for system architecture, technical decision-making, and project delivery of complex signaling and train control solutions.
Strong systems engineering and integration background, including requirements management, subsystem integration, interface management, system verification & validation (V&V), testing, commissioning, migration planning, and revenue service implementation.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams across signaling, train control, communications, cybersecurity, safety, and infrastructure disciplines while driving technical excellence, schedule adherence, and project performance.
Customer-facing technical leadership skills, with the ability to serve as the primary technical interface to transit agencies, customers, and stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into actionable solutions and resolving critical system-level challenges.
Experience managing safety-critical rail systems, with a strong understanding of technical risk management, change control processes, regulatory compliance, and the successful deployment of operationally critical train control solutions.
Proven ability to lead technical governance and change management activities, including Change Control Boards (CCB), design reviews, technical issue resolution, and cross-functional decision-making while balancing contractual, schedule, cost, and performance requirements.

What will make you stand out:

Experience delivering CBTC projects for major transit agencies and/or prior experience with Siemens Mobility, Alstom, Hitachi Rail, Thales, Wabtec, Bombardier Transportation, Ansaldo STS, or similar rail signaling organizations is highly preferred.

Purpose is the reason a company exists. It's not about making money or selling products - it's the deeper "why" behind everything we do. It answers the question: What problem are we solving? What positive change are we creating?

For Siemens, our purpose has been clear for over 175 years: We create technology to transform the everyday, for everyone.

The world needs technologies that work. Technologies that matter. Technologies that solve today's challenges and help shape a better tomorrow. And that's exactly what we build. By bringing together the real world (factories, buildings, power grids, trains) with the digital world (software, data, AI, digital twins), we help our customers become more competitive, resilient, and sustainable.

Our technology is everywhere
- in trains and transportation,
we help move people faster, safer, and more sustainably.

This position is located in New York, NY. The salary range for this position is $155,754.00 - $170,000.00 and the annual incentive target is 10% of the base salary.
The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications and premium geographic location.

new_jobs.title: Associate Vice President - Land Development
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Pape-Dawson’s Miramar Beach team and build your career just steps from the beautiful beaches of Florida’s Emerald Coast. Established through the acquisition of Innerlight Engineering, our Miramar Beach office combines decades of local experience, trusted client relationships, and a strong commitment to client service. The team has earned an excellent reputation throughout the Florida Panhandle by delivering responsive, high-quality support across every phase of a project.

From major development initiatives to essential infrastructure improvements, our professionals contribute to projects that are shaping the future of the region. Team members have the opportunity to make a visible impact, collaborate closely with clients and public agencies, and enjoy an office location within walking distance of the beach—bringing together meaningful work and an exceptional coastal lifestyle.

We are seeking an Associate Vice President (AVP) - Land Development
for our Miramar Beach, FL location. This person will provide senior-level leadership for the planning, design, and delivery of complex engineering projects for Land Development. The AVP operates at a strategic level, guiding project execution, mentoring managers and senior staff, supporting business development efforts, and serving as a key liaison between technical teams and executive, administrative, and financial leadership. This position represents the company in client, industry, and community settings and plays a critical role in sustaining long-term growth and client relationships.

Responsibilities

Manage land development projects through planning, design, permitting, and implementation.
Provide leadership for multidisciplinary teams supporting private and municipal development projects.
Oversee all phases of project delivery, from planning and conceptual design through final design, permitting, and construction or implementation support.
Lead, mentor, and supervise managers, project leaders, and senior technical staff; support professional development and succession planning.
Manage multiple teams and complex projects concurrently, ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations.
Review and approve proposals, scopes of work, budgets, and client agreements to ensure alignment with company standards and business objectives.
Support business development activities, including pursuit strategy, proposal development, RFQs/RFPs, and client interviews.
Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with clients, public agencies, industry partners, and community leaders.
Ensure consistent application and advancement of company design, production, and quality control standards across projects and teams.
Collaborate with executive leadership, operations, and finance to assess staffing needs, resource allocation, and market conditions.
Represent the company through active participation in professional associations, industry organizations, and civic groups.

Qualifications

Bachelor of Science degree in Civil Engineering (or related engineering discipline where applicable) from an ABET-accredited program.
Licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) in the state of FL.
12+ years of progressive engineering experience, including senior-level project leadership and people management responsibilities.
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor managers, project leaders, and senior technical professionals.
Proven experience managing complex projects, multiple teams, and competing priorities simultaneously.
